body: Lil Baby got frustrated with a man at his table while playing at the casino, saying the person was throwing off his good luck. “Don’t be f**king up my good luck bruh…” He later jumped into the comments of the clip circulating on social media to let fans know he was still “If you see me talking I’m winning !! ” he wrote, before adding, “Kids don’t gamble” and “Kids don’t drink liquor. ”.
